inputs.text: This latest case out of New York City shows exactly why sanctuary policies are a betrayal of American families and our national security. Releasing an illegal immigrant gang member into our neighborhoods despite clear warnings puts law-abiding citizens in harm's way and undermines the rule of law. Only federal action by ICE, as the DHS reports confirm, finally stepped in to make the arrest and restore order. These progressive sanctuary schemes weaken our borders, erode national authority, and disregard the protection of traditional communities built on personal responsibility and cultural continuity. They are not harmless experiments; they actively damage the social order that keeps our country strong.
